summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything I traced the full path end-to-end without changing anything:  - **Client** (`WatchlistPage.tsx`, `useAuth.tsx`, `lib/api.ts`): all requests go through the shared `api` client with `credentials: "include"`; no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere for watchlists (only theme uses localStorage). `activeId` lives in React state only, re-fetched from `/watchlist` on every mount. - **Server auth** (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`): every route is wrapped in its own `router.use("*", ...)` middleware
